SELECT p.id AS project_id, p.project_no, p.title, p.project_type, d.name AS dept_name, u.display_name AS pi_name, p.status, p.start_date, p.end_date, COALESCE((SELECT bv.total_amount FROM budget_version bv WHERE bv.project_id = p.id AND bv.status = 'EFFECTIVE' ORDER BY bv.version_no DESC LIMIT 1), 0) AS budget_total, COALESCE((SELECT SUM(bb.paid_amount) FROM budget_version bv JOIN budget_line bl ON bl.budget_version_id = bv.id JOIN budget_balance bb ON bb.budget_line_id = bl.id WHERE bv.project_id = p.id AND bv.status = 'EFFECTIVE'), 0) AS paid_amount, (SELECT r.risk_level FROM project_risk r WHERE r.project_id = p.id AND r.status IN ('OPEN', 'PROCESSING', 'ESCALATED') ORDER BY CASE r.risk_level WHEN 'CRITICAL' THEN 4 WHEN 'HIGH' THEN 3 WHEN 'MEDIUM' THEN 2 ELSE 1 END DESC, r.created_at DESC LIMIT 1) AS risk_level FROM project p LEFT JOIN org_unit d ON d.id = p.dept_id LEFT JOIN iam_user u ON u.id = p.pi_id WHERE TRUE
ORDER BY p.created_at DESC, p.id LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}
SELECT COUNT(1) FROM project p WHERE TRUE

SELECT p.id AS project_id, p.project_no, p.title, p.project_type, p.pi_id, u.display_name AS pi_name, p.dept_id, d.name AS dept_name, pb.id AS baseline_id, pb.version_no AS baseline_version, p.status, p.start_date, p.end_date, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM project_member pm WHERE pm.project_id = p.id AND pm.status = 'ACTIVE' AND pm.valid_from <= now() AND (pm.valid_to IS NULL OR pm.valid_to > now())) AS member_count, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM milestone m WHERE m.baseline_id = pb.id AND m.status <> 'CANCELLED') AS milestone_total, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM milestone m WHERE m.baseline_id = pb.id AND m.status = 'COMPLETED') AS milestone_completed, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM progress_report pr WHERE pr.project_id = p.id AND pr.due_date <= CURRENT_DATE AND pr.status IN ('DRAFT', 'RETURNED')) AS report_due, COALESCE((SELECT bv.total_amount FROM budget_version bv WHERE bv.project_id = p.id AND bv.status = 'EFFECTIVE' ORDER BY bv.version_no DESC LIMIT 1), 0) AS budget_total, COALESCE((SELECT SUM(bb.approved_amount - bb.reserved_amount - bb.approved_unpaid_amount - bb.paid_amount) FROM budget_version bv JOIN budget_line bl ON bl.budget_version_id = bv.id JOIN budget_balance bb ON bb.budget_line_id = bl.id WHERE bv.project_id = p.id AND bv.status = 'EFFECTIVE'), 0) AS available_amount, (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT ro.id) FROM output_project_relation opr JOIN research_output ro ON ro.id = opr.output_id WHERE opr.project_id = p.id AND opr.status = 'ACTIVE' AND ro.status <> 'REVOKED') AS output_count, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM project_risk r WHERE r.project_id = p.id AND r.status IN ('OPEN', 'PROCESSING', 'ESCALATED')) AS open_risk_count, p.created_at, p.updated_at FROM project p LEFT JOIN org_unit d ON d.id = p.dept_id LEFT JOIN iam_user u ON u.id = p.pi_id LEFT JOIN project_baseline pb ON pb.project_id = p.id AND pb.status = 'EFFECTIVE' WHERE p.id = #{projectId}
